routes: Existing PBS/Machine/resource drawer History batch reader
Existing Storage physical disk shared History reader
states: Real same-origin 503 responses retain stored samples with explicit warnings in both production readers
Real final HTTP 403 responses withdraw samples, tooltip, keyboard announcement, sliders and formerly displayed current-only legends
Access-denied guidance fits light desktop Chromium and dark touch WebKit without horizontal overflow
The existing focusable scoped retry remains mounted and ignores duplicate activation while busy
Earlier cached ranges and remounts cannot resurrect denied stored readings while a replacement is pending
Only a new successful read restores History and clears denial; old values do not return
Every final screenshot inspected; fixed Playwright 1.56.1 equals integration lock, no page errors or off-origin data requests
interactions: Inspect by desktop keyboard and phone tap
limitations: Direct production readers/client with synthetic HTTP responses, not a complete native PBS/NAS drawer, session revocation, appliance collection or release acceptance.
401 is covered by runtime regressions; the real API client redirects on 401, not bypassed for browser proof.
Independently supplied current readings remain distinctly current during a new pending query; they are not stored History.
